caption: Decide your limits before you enter a trade. A written plan helps you review decisions calmly. Risk management cannot eliminate losses. What belongs in your trading checklist?

slides.title: Plan the risk first.
slides.body: Define your position size and loss limit before entering a trade.
slides.alt_text: Minimal STOXRA education card on a white background with purple branding and an orange accent. Plan the risk first: define position size and loss limit before entering a trade.

slides.title: Review the decision.
slides.body: Keep a journal. Review the process behind each trade, including the losses.
slides.alt_text: Second STOXRA card reads: Review the decision. Keep a journal and review the process behind each trade, including losses.
